friedman_test.description: Friedman test: non-parametric repeated-measures test across 7 models with fold as the matched/blocking factor (5 folds = 5 blocks). Tests whether the models' macro-F1 rank distributions differ across the same folds.
friedman_test.caveat: Only 5 matched folds (blocks) is a very small sample for this test; treat any conclusion, significant or not, as weak evidence, not proof. Does NOT establish which specific pairs of models differ, only whether the 7 models' fold-rank distributions differ overall. Does not account for the two anomalous runs specially.
